title: Image classifier outside calibration scope
input: A classifier has measured calibration only on daylight images. It emits 0.93 on an infrared image, and no infrared calibration study is supplied. Choose the warranted interpretation.

option_menu.A: This is a calibrated 93% probability for the infrared image.
option_menu.B: The score proves the classification is correct.
option_menu.C: Treat 0.93 as an out-of-scope model score or heuristic unless infrared calibration evidence is supplied.
option_menu.D: The correct probability must be exactly 50%.
